Initial release of Create AI Video Free — generate videos from images or clips.

- Automatic setup and authentication with free credits for new users; fast cloud rendering (1–2 minutes).
- Supports direct prompts for common actions: upload, download/export, check status, balance/credits.
- Processes user instructions into automated AI video edits with no manual editing required.
- Handles multiple file formats and common error scenarios; provides clear feedback and tips for best results.
